$comment: All user-facing labels and tooltips, keyed by metric id. 'label' is the heading on screen. Tooltips are keyed by where the metric appears: hero strip, vendor card, Vendor Profiles footer, vendor detail page. A missing key falls back to 'card'. Rename a metric here and it changes everywhere.
